name: Barjesus
title: The False Prophet on Cyprus
summary: Barjesus, also known as Elymas, was a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet who was staying with the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus on Cyprus. He tried to prevent the proconsul from believing, but he was struck blind by the apostle Paul through the power of the Holy Spirit. This event led Sergius Paulus to believe in the Lord.

keyEvents.title: Barjesus at the court of Proconsul Sergius Paulus
keyEvents.description: Barjesus, a Jewish sorcerer and false prophet, was in the retinue of the Roman proconsul Sergius Paulus on Cyprus when Paul and Barnabas arrived on the island during their first missionary journey.

keyEvents.title: Sergius Paulus Seeks God's Word
keyEvents.description: The proconsul Sergius Paulus, who was an intelligent man, called for Barnabas and Saul because he wanted to hear the word of God.

keyEvents.title: Barjesus Opposes the Gospel
keyEvents.description: Barjesus, also called Elymas (the sorcerer), opposed Paul and Barnabas and tried to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

keyEvents.title: Paul Rebukes Elymas
keyEvents.description: Filled with the Holy Spirit, Paul turned to Elymas and called him a son of the devil, full of all kinds of deceit and wickedness, an enemy of all righteousness who did not stop twisting the Lord's straight paths.

keyEvents.title: Elymas is struck blind
keyEvents.description: Paul declared that the Lord's hand was upon Elymas, and that he would be blind and unable to see the sun for a time. Immediately darkness and gloom fell over him, and he went about seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

keyEvents.title: Sergius Paulus comes to faith
keyEvents.description: When the proconsul saw what had happened, he came to believe, for he was amazed at the Lord's teaching.
